body.en: Coverage of Meta's newly launched Muse AI agent, which can act on a user's saved Instagram content, such as turning saved reels into recipe suggestions.
body.zh: 报道了Meta新推出的Muse AI智能体，它能处理用户保存的Instagram内容，例如把收藏的短视频转化为食谱建议。

title.en: Instagram Muse launched: Mark Zuckerberg unveils Meta's personal AI agent that can complete tasks on your behalf
title.zh: Instagram Muse launched: Mark Zuckerberg unveils Meta's personal AI agent that can complete tasks on your behalf

body.en: Zuckerberg unveiled Muse, a personal AI agent inside Meta's apps that can look through saved content like Instagram reels and complete tasks on a user's behalf.
body.zh: 扎克伯格发布了Muse，这是Meta应用内的个人AI代理，能够浏览用户保存的Instagram短视频等内容并代为完成任务。

title.en: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg Introduces Muse: Meta’s AI Agent That Can Act, Plan & Work For You 24/7
title.zh: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg Introduces Muse: Meta’s AI Agent That Can Act, Plan & Work For You 24/7

body.en: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg introduced Muse, a new Meta AI agent designed to act, plan and work autonomously for users around the clock.
body.zh: Meta CEO马克·扎克伯格发布了新的AI智能体Muse，该产品可以自主行动、规划并全天候为用户工作。

title.en: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg declares, 'Threads is bigger than X,' as active users surpass Musk's platform
title.zh: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg declares, 'Threads is bigger than X,' as active users surpass Musk's platform

body.en: Zuckerberg publicly claimed Threads' active users now surpass or rival Musk's X, a notable competitive milestone in the social platform race.
body.zh: 扎克伯格公开宣称Threads的活跃用户数已超过或接近马斯克的X，这是社交平台竞争中一个值得关注的里程碑。

title.en: Meta Muse Surprise Launch: Get Your 24/7 Functional AI Virtual Machine for Free | Mark Zuckerberg’s Vision for AI to "Earn Its Own Keep"
title.zh: Meta Muse Surprise Launch: Get Your 24/7 Functional AI Virtual Machine for Free | Mark Zuckerberg’s Vision for AI to "Earn Its Own Keep"

body.en: Meta surprise-launched Muse, a free 24/7 AI virtual machine app, part of Zuckerberg's push for AI products to 'earn their own keep.'
body.zh: Meta突然推出了Muse，一款免费的24/7 AI虚拟机应用，这是扎克伯格推动AI产品“自我造血”战略的一部分。

title.en: What is Muse? Mark Zuckerberg introduces Meta’s new personal AI agent and how to use it?
title.zh: What is Muse? Mark Zuckerberg introduces Meta’s new personal AI agent and how to use it?

body.en: Mark Zuckerberg introduced Muse, a new personal AI agent from Meta.
body.zh: 马克·扎克伯格发布了Muse，这是Meta新推出的个人AI代理产品。

title.en: “Works 24/7 to get things done for you”, says Mark Zuckerberg as Meta enters autonomous AI race with launch of personal AI agent Muse
title.zh: “Works 24/7 to get things done for you”, says Mark Zuckerberg as Meta enters autonomous AI race with launch of personal AI agent Muse

body.en: Zuckerberg announced Meta's entry into the autonomous personal-agent race with the launch of Muse, an AI agent pitched as working '24/7' on the user's behalf.
body.zh: 扎克伯格宣布Meta推出个人AI代理Muse，正式进军自主智能体赛道，该代理被宣传为可“24/7”替用户处理事务。

title.en: META Stock Rises Premarket: Zuckerberg Says Threads Is ‘Either Bigger Than X’ Or Close In Scale
title.zh: META Stock Rises Premarket: Zuckerberg Says Threads Is ‘Either Bigger Than X’ Or Close In Scale

body.en: Zuckerberg said Threads is now either bigger than X or close to it in scale, a claim reported alongside a premarket rise in Meta stock.
body.zh: 扎克伯格表示Threads目前的规模已超过X，或已非常接近，该言论与Meta股价盘前上涨的消息一同被报道。

title.en: Instagram Muse launched: Mark Zuckerberg unveils Meta's personal AI agent that can complete tasks on your...
title.zh: Instagram Muse launched: Mark Zuckerberg unveils Meta's personal AI agent that can complete tasks on your...

body.en: Zuckerberg unveiled Muse, Meta's new personal AI agent built into Instagram that can complete tasks for users, part of Meta's push into consumer AI agents.
body.zh: 扎克伯格发布了Meta的新个人AI助手Muse，该功能整合进Instagram，可代用户完成任务，是Meta在消费级AI智能体方向的最新推进。

title.en: Mark Zuckerberg on Muse, Meta's biggest AI bet yet
title.zh: Mark Zuckerberg on Muse, Meta's biggest AI bet yet

body.en: Meta launched Muse, described as Zuckerberg's biggest AI product bet yet, a personal AI agent meant to act on users' behalf.
body.zh: Meta推出Muse，被称为扎克伯格迄今为止在AI领域最大的一次押注，这是一款可代表用户行事的个人AI智能体。

title.zh: Mark Zuckerberg Opposes Federal AI Watchdog in Call With Trump: Report

body.en: Mark Zuckerberg reportedly opposed creating a federal AI watchdog in a call with President Trump.
body.zh: 据报道，马克·扎克伯格在与特朗普总统的通话中反对设立联邦AI监管机构。

title.en: Mark Zuckerberg Opposes Federal AI Watchdog in Call With Trump: Report
title.zh: Mark Zuckerberg Opposes Federal AI Watchdog in Call With Trump: Report

body.en: Zuckerberg privately told Trump he opposes a proposed federal AI safety watchdog, a stance reported to have shifted White House AI policy.
body.zh: 扎克伯格在与特朗普的私下通话中表示反对拟议的联邦AI安全监管机构，据报道该立场影响了白宫的AI政策。

title.zh: Mark Zuckerberg Opposes Federal AI Watchdog in Call With Trump: Report

title.en: Meta's New Model Matches Fable 5 Performance, Mark Zuckerberg Says: Fully Open-Source With Ultra-Affordable Cost That Makes Calculations Unnecessary
title.zh: Meta's New Model Matches Fable 5 Performance, Mark Zuckerberg Says: Fully Open-Source With Ultra-Affordable Cost That Makes Calculations Unnecessary

body.en: Zuckerberg said Meta's newly released model matches Fable 5's performance while being fully open-source and dramatically cheaper to run, a major open-weight release.
body.zh: 扎克伯格表示Meta新发布的模型性能可比肩Fable 5，且完全开源、运行成本大幅降低，是一次重要的开放权重模型发布。

title.en: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg: Opposes National AI Regulatory Agency
title.zh: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg: Opposes National AI Regulatory Agency

body.en: Zuckerberg came out against creating a national AI regulatory agency in the US, a notable policy stance from Meta's CEO.
body.zh: 扎克伯格公开反对美国设立国家级AI监管机构，这是Meta CEO在政策问题上的一次值得关注的表态。

title.zh: How Mark Zuckerberg and Elon Musk made the case for AI at the G20 meeting

body.en: Zuckerberg joined Elon Musk in publicly making the case for AI development at the G20 meeting.
body.zh: 扎克伯格与埃隆·马斯克在G20会议上共同为AI发展公开发声。

title.zh: What did Mark Zuckerberg said in his 6,500-word AI manifesto?

body.zh: 马克·扎克伯格发表一篇6500字的宣言，阐述他对AI的愿景。

title.en: Mark Zuckerberg's Meta Just Open-Sourced Its Most Powerful AI Model to Take on OpenAI and Anthropic. Should Investors Watch Meta's AI Spending Closely?
title.zh: Mark Zuckerberg's Meta Just Open-Sourced Its Most Powerful AI Model to Take on OpenAI and Anthropic. Should Investors Watch Meta's AI Spending Closely?

body.en: Meta released its most capable model yet under an open licence, positioning it directly against OpenAI and Anthropic and reopening the question of how long Zuckerberg's AI spending can run.
body.zh: Meta 以开源许可发布了迄今最强的模型，直接对标 OpenAI 与 Anthropic，也让外界重新审视扎克伯格 AI 投入的持续性。

title.en: Mark Zuckerberg’s Meta Agreed to a $17 Billion Settlement—Bernie Sanders Calls It a ‘Good Step Forward,’ But Says 'Much More Needs to Be Done' (UPDATED)
title.zh: Mark Zuckerberg’s Meta Agreed to a $17 Billion Settlement—Bernie Sanders Calls It a ‘Good Step Forward,’ But Says 'Much More Needs to Be Done' (UPDATED)

body.en: Meta agreed to a settlement of roughly 17 billion dollars over social media harms, with Bernie Sanders calling it a step forward but far from enough.
body.zh: Meta 就社交媒体危害相关诉讼达成约170亿美元的和解，伯尼·桑德斯称这是向前一步，但远远不够。

title.en: Mark Zuckerberg wanted to cut Meta teams by 60%, but AI agents had other plans
title.zh: Mark Zuckerberg wanted to cut Meta teams by 60%, but AI agents had other plans

body.en: Reports say Zuckerberg had wanted to cut Meta teams by 60% as AI agents took over more work, revealing how aggressively AI is reshaping the company's staffing plans.
body.zh: 报道称扎克伯格曾希望在AI智能体接管更多工作后将Meta团队裁减60%，显示AI正在深刻改变公司的人员规划。

title.zh: What did Mark Zuckerberg say in his AI manifesto?

body.en: Zuckerberg publishes an AI manifesto laying out Meta's direction, drawing mainstream explainer coverage of the stance.
body.zh: 扎克伯格发布 AI 宣言，阐述 Meta 的路线，主流媒体随即对其立场逐条解读。
